header: What every relaunch needs, already built
subheadline: Content elements, components and a theme layer in one Composer package. Agencies usually rebuild these parts for every project.

items.title: 244 content elements
items.description: Heroes, features, pricing, dashboards and footers in ten groups. Each element has a backend preview.

items.title: 62 Fluid components
items.description: 17 atoms, 37 molecules, 4 layouts and 4 organisms. Your own templates use the same design language as the bundled ones.

items.title: 15 theme presets
items.description: Switch from Aurora to Midnight while the site runs. The whole site changes, with no rebuild and no deployment.
